implementation: The scheduler gives each stream an independent score/probability/scale/PV-error/index/counter arena. Input preparation completes before any consumer. Consecutive128-query slabs use round-robin slots, preserving all same-slot dependencies. At most eight slabs are queued before every active stream completes. Original launch_queries and prepared-QK callback arguments retain layout22, final PV bound, direct operands, transpose, exact K16 and K32 recurrences and selected replay. No product provider imports the scheduler. Original control uses the default stream with one completion per slab; queued control and two/four-stream variants use nonblocking streams. Identical arithmetic and disjoint query ranges do not by themselves establish simultaneous physical GPU execution.
correctness_scope: The actual host scheduler is sanitizer-tested on complete and partial windows, exact query coverage, zero submissions for invalid settings, failed partial submissions, deadline faults and failed completions; all pending peers receive cleanup attempts and unsuccessful completion is explicitly reported. Native48 generated reports cover nonzero inputs, subnormal Q/K fallback, zero V, arbitrary query_start, output_start3, small/partial slabs and multiwindow tails. All variants and both attempts compare raw outputs, output unused rows, scratch redzones, original Q/K/V, both transposes and independently reconstructed complete prepared arrays including unused capacity. Zero V additionally requires exact positive FP32 zero. Both capture shapes run one warmup plus three rotated full-shape samples per variant and check all raw output cells and all29364224 original external GB10 BF16 cells on every attempt. The q8192 tail repeats the last captured row1023 times and is compared only with original computation. The GB10 reference is never a compute input. Native normal exit also verifies both lookup tables after all reports.
timing_scope: Completed steady-host clocks span all QK, online probability, approximate PV, candidate collection, exact replay, submission and completion for the complete requested query span. One shared timed Q/K preparation and K/V transpose is added to each arm. Allocation, four precreated nonblocking streams, four resident scratch arenas, resets, validation, CPU layout construction and lookup-table load are outside. Active scratch counts describe variant use, not different total residency during this comparison. Generated one-sample clocks are safety diagnostics. Component measurements do not establish TTFT, engine load, continuation, HTTP or release performance.

decision.reason: All tested arithmetic and external GB10 cells agree. At q8192 the two/four-stream medians are slower than the single-stream queued-eight control by9.5669/17.5412ms while active scratch doubles/quadruples. Three-sample spreads also exceed these differences. This provides no evidence of a seconds-scale model improvement from overlapping independent slabs. Keep the existing product scheduling; no provider DLL or real-model run is warranted by this result.
